ix: IX means denoting a quantity consisting of one more than eight and one less than ten.
IX can also mean the cardinal number that is the sum of eight and one.
IX means the same as nine or 9 or niner.
ixia: Ixia is a monocotyledonous genus of the family Iridaceae.
Ixia means the same as genus Ixia.
ixobrychus: Ixobrychus means the same as genus Ixobrychus.
ixobrychus exilis: Ixobrychus exilis is small American bittern.
Ixobrychus exilis means the same as least bittern.
ixodes: Ixodes is type genus of the family Ixodidae.
Ixodes means the same as genus Ixodes.
ixodes dammini: Ixodes dammini is a northeastern tick now recognized as same species as Ixodes scapularis.
Ixodes dammini means the same as deer tick.
ixodes dentatus: Ixodes dentatus is usually does not bite humans.
ixodes neotomae: Ixodes neotomae is a tick that usually does not bite humans.
ixodes pacificus: Ixodes pacificus is a tick that feeds on dusky-footed wood rat and bites humans.
Ixodes pacificus means the same as western black-legged tick.
ixodes ricinus: Ixodes ricinus is parasitic on sheep and cattle as well as humans.
Ixodes ricinus means the same as sheep-tick or sheep tick.
ixodes scapularis: Ixodes scapularis is parasitic on mice of genus Peromyscus and bites humans.
Ixodes scapularis means the same as black-legged tick.
ixodes spinipalpis: Ixodes spinipalpis is usually does not bite humans.
ixodid: Ixodid is ticks having a hard shield on the back and mouth parts that project from the head.
Ixodid means the same as hard tick.
ixodidae: Ixodidae means the same as family Ixodidae.
ixc: Ixc means being nine more than eighty.
Ixc means the same as eighty-nine or 89.
ixl: Ixl means being nine more than thirty.
Ixl means the same as thirty-nine or 39.
